name: calib_transmittance_tinted
_why: As calib_transmittance, but with the pale-green albedo of matlight_pbr_subset's glass sphere, so the prediction becomes (1 - F)^2 * albedo^2 -- the ORDER of the tint, not just its magnitude. glTF's transmission BTDF multiplies by the base colour once per interface crossed, so a solid must square it; a renderer that tints once, or three times, fails here and nowhere else in this suite. See REPORT.md section 9.3.1.
